text:
maria: Quick async check — where are we on the dedicated capacity buildout for west-1? Need procurement ETA, rack power status, and who owns reservation assignment for the first 10 nodes. Planning to flip on canary next Tue. TL;DR please.
aj: PO submitted to vendor (PO# 78942). Vendor confirms partial ship 2024-03-28 (3 crates via LCL), remainder 2024-04-10. BOL: BOL-X9Y. H100s only; vendor reported 80% with custom brackets. Rack PDUs delivered to colo yesterday but we're missing C13 cable kits. Crate arrival window: 2024-03-28 — 2024-04-12.
kevin: For runtime: we can stage 2 canary hosts in the lab tomorrow. Need image with CUDA 12.2 + container runtime pinned. Can someone open the IP/VLAN reservation ticket? Also confirm commit size — is it 10 nodes?
sasha: Reservation ownership sits with platform-team, will hand off to runtime for canary. I'll take ownership of assigning the first 10 nodes. Which customers are first in line?
maria: First customers are Acme and QuantumAnalytics (both west-1). Also keep 2 nodes for internal perf/benchmarks. Goal: flip canary Tue EOD if canaries pass.
aj: Power team flagged rack-04 requires breaker swap (capacity upgrade). Scheduled 2024-03-26 02:00–04:00 UTC. If that slips fallback is rack-07. I'll attach breaker ticket and patch schedule. We also need on-site ethernet patch crew for cable mapping.
kevin: Will open PR for image config today: branch `h100-image` -> deps: CUDA=12.2, cuDNN=8.6, runtime-agent=v1.4.0. Note: KV-cache tuning behaves differently on H100; plan perf job after staging.
maria: @aj please attach BOL and customs paperwork to the procurement ticket. @sasha can you confirm SLA start date (billing cutover)?
sasha: Confirmed — SLA start = day of node assignment. I'll notify CS to pause billing until capacity is green. I'll also draft a 1-pager runbook for canary rollback and share in this thread.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for cluster-west-1-canary
kevin: Perf plan: 3 runs of 1k prompts, seq_len=1024, batch=8. I'll post throughput/latency + token-cost numbers in #eng-runtime when done.
maria: Action items recap: aj -> attach docs + confirm breaker swap window; sasha -> assign 10 nodes + runbook + notify CS; kevin -> image PR + perf jobs; I'll do a quick sync Mon 10:00 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
